input.sql:
SELECT
  'null_amount' AS check_name,
  COUNT_IF(amount IS NULL) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'negative_amount' AS check_name,
  COUNT_IF(amount < 0) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'duplicate_order_id' AS check_name,
  COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'orphan_customer' AS check_name,
  COUNT(*) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders o
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_customers c WHERE c.customer_id = o.customer_id
)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'future_order_date' AS check_name,
  COUNT_IF(order_date > DATE '2026-11-01') AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'invalid_status' AS check_name,
  COUNT_IF(status NOT IN ('new', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled') OR status IS NULL) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders

SELECT
  COUNT(*) as total_rows,
  COUNT(order_id) as non_null_order_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as distinct_order_id,
  COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as diff_order_id
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders

SELECT
  COUNT(*) as total_orphans,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN o.customer_id IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_customer_id,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN c.customer_id IS NULL THEN 1 END) as missing_in_customers
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders o
LEFT JOIN workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_customers c
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
SELECT status, count(*) FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders GROUP BY status

SELECT
  min(order_date),
  max(order_date),
  count_if(order_date > DATE '2026-11-01'),
  count_if(order_date >= DATE '2026-11-01'),
  count_if(order_date = DATE '2026-11-01')
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders
SELECT count_if(order_date IS NULL) FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders

SELECT
  count_if(amount IS NULL) AS null_amount,
  count_if(amount < 0) AS negative_amount,
  count_if(amount = 0) AS zero_amount,
  count_if(amount > 0) AS positive_amount
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders

SELECT
  sum(cnt - 1) as sum_extra_rows
FROM (
  SELECT order_id, count(*) as cnt
  FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders
  GROUP BY order_id
  HAVING count(*) > 1
)

SELECT count(*)
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders
WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_customers WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL)
SELECT count(*) FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders WHERE order_date > '2026-11-01'
SELECT count(*) FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders WHERE status NOT IN ('new', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')
SHOW TABLES IN workspace.exam_xe9749

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_report AS
SELECT CAST('null_amount' AS STRING) AS check_name, CAST(COUNT_IF(amount IS NULL) AS BIGINT) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST('negative_amount' AS STRING) AS check_name, CAST(COUNT_IF(amount < 0) AS BIGINT) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST('duplicate_order_id' AS STRING) AS check_name, CAST(COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS BIGINT) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST('orphan_customer' AS STRING) AS check_name, CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders o
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_customers c WHERE c.customer_id = o.customer_id
)
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST('future_order_date' AS STRING) AS check_name, CAST(COUNT_IF(order_date > DATE '2026-11-01') AS BIGINT) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST('invalid_status' AS STRING) AS check_name, CAST(COUNT_IF(status NOT IN ('new', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled') OR status IS NULL) AS BIGINT) AS failing_rows
FROM workspace.exam_xe9749.dq_orders
